scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx,css,scss,html}" index.html vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
